Subject: Drummond Home & Garden - Quote in Progress

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the submission on Drummond Home & Garden. I have everything I need to move forward with pricing.

I'll work this up and aim to get you a competitive quote by end of week. The risk looks clean at first glance, and the loss history should help us sharpen our pencil.

I'll reach out if any questions come up while I'm reviewing, but otherwise expect something from me soon.

Thanks for thinking of us on this one!

Best,
